Die Happy Fit-App von hello again ist eine Kundenbindungs-App, die für alle iOS Smartphones verfügbar ist.

With Skiline you can easily see and share what you have been up to on the slopes. Simply scan your ski pass with your smartphone to find out how far you skied, the altitude that you covered and what lifts you’ve taken. Treasure your skiing experiences forever. 

App Functions:
• Vertical meters
• Downhill distance
• Lift rides
• Action videos and speed photos
• Photopoint souvenir photos
• Friends Feed
• Family Feature
• Competitions
• Battery-saving – doesn’t require GPS
• Enter ticket with NFC

Getting started is easy:
1. Install the app
2. Create a Skiline account or log in through Facebook
3. Scan your ski pass number
4. Done!
